# Import audit (2026-10-12)

The accountant reported that imports "don't work": the opening-balance PDF failed (handled separately), and so did bank
statement conversion. This audit sends every import path through its **production code** using realistic synthetic
fixtures, and fixes everything that failed.

* **Fixtures**: `apps/web/test/import/fixtures/` are generated by `apps/web/test/import/gen-fixtures.mjs` (run
  `cd apps/web && node test/import/gen-fixtures.mjs`). The PDFs have a real text layer: they are HTML pages
  rendered by Chromium, and the tests read them back with pdfjs. `expected.json` holds what each file must import as.
  All data is invented. The layouts follow what Macedonian banks print: a header block with account, statement
  number, date or period and balances; headers repeated on every page; page footers; multi-line text; MK
  `1.234,56` and dot `1,234.56` numbers; amounts printed a little below the text line.
* **Tests**:
  * `apps/web/test/import/import-audit.test.ts` (36 tests): PDF → pdfjs → reader, converter, /banka, invoices,
    master data.
  * `apps/worker/src/ai/free-read.test.ts` and `noai.test.ts`: the worker's free reader and the read job.
  * `packages/core/src/bank/table.test.ts`: the statement-table normaliser, including the exact Халк grid from the
    report.

## Bank statements

"Before" means `main` at b8255cc. Each cell shows the transactions read with exact amounts out of the total.
Opening + movements = closing is checked wherever the statement prints its balances.

| Bank / layout (fixture) | PDF without AI (worker) | PDF in converter | Excel on /banka | Excel in converter | CSV |

| ПроКредит: bilingual headings, ISO dates, dot numbers (`pcb`) | ❌ 7/8 → ✅ | ❌ 1/8 → ✅ | – | – | ✅ → ✅ |
| УНИ: **amounts 3.5 pt below the text line** (baseline offset) (`uni`) | ❌ 4/8 → ✅ | ❌ 4/8 → ✅ | – | – | – |
| Силк Роуд: „Почетно / Крајно салдо“, 3-line descriptions (`silk`) | ✅ → ✅ | ✅ → ✅ | – | – | – |
| ТТК: „Дат. книж.“ / „Дат. вал.“, two-digit years `05.03.26` (`ttk`) | ❌ nothing read → ✅ | ❌ blocked: „Датум“ → ✅ | – | – | – |
| ЦКБ: one signed „Износ“ with a trailing minus `1.234,56-`, „Жиро сметка“ (`ckb`) | ❌ nothing read → ✅ | ❌ columns not recognised → ✅ | – | – | – |
| XML (Халк `RacunPrivredaIzvod`, camt.053), MT940, Комерцијална `.300` | ✅ → ✅ (golden tests `packages/core/test/golden/bank`) | | | | |
| Девизни изводи | Same readers. Currency and exchange rate come from `planImport` (existing tests). | | | | |
| PDF scan / photo | Needs AI. Without AI the read says so (unchanged). | | | | |

After the fix, every PDF bank fixture also reconciles (opening + movements = closing), and its statement number,
account, opening and closing balance are read. The file the converter downloads is imported on /banka with the same
lines, number, account and balances.

## What was fixed

1. **`packages/core/src/bank/table.ts`** (new) is one statement-table normaliser, shared by the Excel / CSV import,
   the PDF reader without AI and the converter. It handles:
   * headers over 1–3 rows: parent and sub-headings, wrapped heading text, a sub-row under the name column;
   * column roles: date / value date / name / account / purpose / reference / code / debit / credit / signed amount
     / balance / ordinal;
   * a column with both directions, where the second amount slipped into the next cell (`0.00 666` is split);
   * a name column that carries the account;
   * transactions over several rows (account line, wrapped purpose, amounts printed below or above the text, an
     ordinal that starts a new item);
   * repeated page headers, page footers, total rows and trailer lines;
   * statement data: number, date (labelled, `… од dd.mm.yyyy`, end of a period, or the only date), account,
     currency, opening / closing balance and turnover. A value can sit after its label, in the next cell, or under
     the label; a label row over a value row also works.
2. **`readBankTable`** (`bank-parsers.ts`) builds on that. Rows without a date take the statement date. A „Д/П“
   indicator gives the sign. Messages are clear and in Macedonian: no header found, no amount column, no date column
   and no statement date, a row whose date / amount cell is not a date / amount (with the row number and the column
   heading), and balances or turnover that do not reconcile (with the difference). `parseBankTable` keeps its
   signature, and the legacy-parity tests are unchanged.
3. **`parseBankDate`** now reads two-digit years and `yyyy.mm.dd`, and rejects impossible dates such as `31.02.2026`.
4. **PDF**:
   * `noai/pdf-rows.ts` (new, a shared helper) groups items into rows while keeping each item.
   * `noai/bank-grid.ts` (new) finds the table header (1–3 lines). It cuts every line item by item, so values
     printed close together stay apart. It learns column extents from the data (headings centred over wider
     columns), joins rows a few points apart (`mergeCloseRows`, the baseline offset), skips the repeated header and
     letterhead on later pages, and pairs label rows with value rows.
   * `statementFromPdfItems` (`noai/bank.ts`) is the worker's free reader. If a table is found but cannot be read,
     it throws `BankPdfError` with the reason, which is stored on the read instead of a generic "no AI" message.
5. **Worker**: a bank PDF with a text layer is first read without AI. If the balances reconcile (opening +
   movements = closing, no warnings), that read is used: exact, with no tokens spent. Otherwise AI reads the
   statement as before.
6. **Converter** (`convert/index.ts`, `konvertor/converter.tsx`, `konvertor/actions.ts`):
   * A target can prepare its source (`ConvTarget.prepare`). The bank target uses the normaliser: the combined
     header, columns mapped by role (задолжува → Одлив, одобрува → Прилив), merged rows and split cells.
   * Header values: a required field can be filled from the file's header block. For example, the statement date
     shows as „од заглавјето: 05.03.2026“ and can be overridden by a column or a typed constant. The setting is
     `convApply(…, { hdr })`.
   * The opening + movements = closing check appears as a green or red note.
   * Statement number, date, account and balances are written into the downloaded file, so /banka reads them.
   * A PDF now also offers a "PDF – табела на извод" sheet, cut by the bank header.
   * A new field „Сметка на налогодавач / примач“ is added.
7. **/banka import**: Excel and CSV errors now name the heading or row. Rows that were left out and balances that do
   not reconcile appear as warnings in the preview, for files and for reads without AI.
8. **Other importers**:
   * `impAuto` / `convAuto` apply synonym priority.
   * `fimpVatFlag` / `fimpVatPeriod` accept Latin spellings („DA“, „3M“, „tromesečno“, „mesečno“).
   * Payroll maps a plain „Боледување“ column.
   * The invoice reader keeps 0 % VAT groups.
